name: Jellyfin Compressor (EXPERIMENTAL)
overview: EXPERIMENTAL: compress movies while keeping recoverable originals.
description: Experimental Jellyfin 10.11.6 movie compressor. Automatic compression is disabled by default. Test with disposable media before use on a real library.

versions.changelog: Experimental preview: the resolution selector now shows the saved limit correctly after reopening the dashboard. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: warns before analysis about unsaved folder changes and selected folders with no Jellyfin movies. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.

Experimental preview: fast analysis and safe cancellation when an analysis just finished. Full identity checks still prevent recompression when queueing. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.

Experimental preview: fast analysis of selected folders, preliminary results and an analysis cancel button. Full identity checks still prevent recompression when queueing. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.

Experimental preview: configurable minimum movie size (10 GB initially) for analysis and batch compression; single-movie manual checks remain available. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: stop oversized encodes early, show final job progress and preserve the original when minimum savings cannot be met. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: background manual analysis and single-movie checks with visible progress and recoverable results. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: queue one movie, select a maximum resolution without upscaling, browse originals folders and adjust file stability. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: redesigned dashboard, visual folder browser and grouped settings. Automatic compression remains disabled by default.
Experimental preview: configurable original-folder size limit, age-based retention and verified cleanup after restoration.
